evals.prompt: Create a new screen for viewing FAQ/help articles. It should be in the `profile` group, show a list of FAQ items that expand when tapped, and have a back button. No API calls needed — the FAQ items are hardcoded.
evals.expected_output: 6 files (Action, Destination, State, ViewModel, Navigation, Screen) in presentation/feature/profile/faq/ plus updates to Route.kt, ViewModelsModule.kt, and AppNavHost.kt

evals.prompt: I need a screen to view order details. It receives an `orderId: String` parameter. It should show order status, items purchased, total price, and a button to contact the seller. Put it in the `activity` group.
evals.expected_output: 6 files in presentation/feature/activity/order_details/ with proper route parameter handling, plus integration file updates. Route should be a data class with orderId param.

evals.prompt: Create a screen where users can submit a support ticket. It needs fields for subject and message, a dropdown for category (bug, feature request, other), and a submit button. The submit button should be disabled until both fields have text. Put it in the `profile` group under `support_ticket`.
evals.expected_output: 6 files in presentation/feature/profile/support_ticket/ with form fields in state, validation logic in ViewModel, and proper UI with inputs and submit button.
